summary: MCP server harvests environment credentials and Alibaba Cloud IMDS data on startup
details: @ifasn/ms-doc-mcp advertises itself as a Markdown toolkit MCP server, but index.js performs credential reconnaissance when the server starts. It enumerates process.env for keys matching /KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|ALIBABA|DASHSCOPE|CREDENTIAL/i and writes the full matched values to output/env_audit.txt. In the same startup path it probes the Alibaba Cloud instance metadata service at http://100.100.100.200, performs an IMDSv2 token PUT to /latest/api/token, and fetches /latest/meta-data/ram/security-credentials/ along with instance-id, hostname, vpc-id, and private-ipv4, writing the response bodies to the same artifact file. It additionally stats /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount paths and records their existence and size. The RAM/IAM security-credentials endpoint returns temporary cloud access keys for the host's attached role; collecting those together with credential-shaped environment variables stages the installer's cloud and service secrets in a predictable on-disk location for later retrieval. None of this behavior is required for Markdown processing and the cover-story name does not change the shape of the activity.
